models.intro: Configure the LLM / embedding model used for each task. All run on local Ollama by default — no cloud keys required. Leave the API key blank to keep the stored secret.
models.maxPromptTokensHint: Optional. RLM prompt-token limit for this model (codebase doc generation). Leave empty to use the default (200000). On large repos the code is split into chunks that each fit this limit.

rlm.intro: Choose whether each task uses the Recursive Language Model (RLM) for large-context reasoning or the standard LLM. RLM is slower but can yield higher quality on very large contexts; it always falls back to LLM on failure. The expert chat also has a per-question override.
rlm.unavailableBanner: fast-rlm is not installed on the server, so every task is forced to **LLM** regardless of the selected mode. Install fast-rlm to enable RLM routing.
rlm.modeAutoHint: RLM for large context, else LLM (recommended)
rlm.modeRlmHint: Always RLM (recursive reasoning), falls back to LLM on failure
rlm.taskDocgenHint: Wiki/artifact doc generation over cloned codebases (large context).
rlm.taskExpertHint: Ask-the-expert answers and document export. Can be overridden per question in the chat.

git.intro: Enterprise / self-hosted Git URLs and access tokens. Leave blank for public GitHub / GitLab.

ssl.intro: TLS configuration for reaching an HTTPS LLM/embedder gateway (e.g. a corporate AI gateway) whose certificate is signed by an internal CA. Either point every client at your corporate root cert (recommended), or disable verification (insecure fallback). Local HTTP Ollama is unaffected.
ssl.caBundleHint: Filesystem path to a .pem/.crt with your corporate root CA. Export it from the OS keychain if needed.
ssl.verifyHint: ON = trust the CA bundle above (or the default store). OFF = skip verification — insecure, MITM risk. Only use when no CA file is available.
ssl.warningOff: Verification is OFF. Connections are vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks.

integrations.intro: Raw integrations config (JSON). Each key maps to a connector registered on the backend.

prompts.intro: Edit the markdown prompt templates in refs/prompts/*.md on the fly — changes take effect on the next generation run.

cognee.intro: Configure rate limits and concurrency for Cognee knowledge graph indexing to prevent LLM API rate limit overflow.
cognee.hint: Throttles LLM and embedding requests generated during graph extraction (cognify). Setting max concurrency to 1-3 and delay to 0.5s prevents 429 Too Many Requests errors.
cognee.reindexSub: Manually trigger re-indexing of all products and artifacts into the Cognee knowledge graph.
cognee.reindexOkMsg: Knowledge graph successfully updated across all products.

timeouts.intro: Centralized timeout management. Each value is resolved with precedence: admin store > env var > default. Leave a field empty to fall back to the env var or the built-in default.

hints.llm_retry_max_time: Backoff retry budget for transient LLM errors.
hints.model_list: HTTP timeout for model listing and existence checks.
hints.provider_test: Timeout for the admin panel connection test.
hints.cognee_cognify: Overall cognify timeout. Allow for multi-hour indexing on large repos.
hints.docgen_indexing_drain: Ceiling for the docgen worker-loop indexing drain. Defaults to cognify so a cognify task isn't dropped.
hints.rlm_api_ms: Per-API-call timeout for fast-rlm (Pyodide reads from env).
hints.rlm_section: Per-section RLM timeout for the docgen path.
hints.rlm_expert: RLM timeout for the expert agent.
hints.git_file_content: HTTP timeout for GitHub/GitLab file-content API fetches.
hints.mcp_stdio_wait: Timeout for .wait() on the MCP stdio subprocess.
hints.mermaid_verify: Per-diagram verification timeout via the Node validator.
hints.mermaid_repair: Per-LLM-call timeout for repairing one diagram.
hints.mermaid_max_repair_attempts: Repair attempt budget per unique diagram body.
